Version 0.0.11 of welderjustin-imap-smtp-email

- No file changes detected in this version.
- No updates or changes to documentation or functionality.

- Improved and expanded SKILL.md documentation, covering both IMAP (email receiving) and SMTP (email sending) capabilities.
- Included detailed configuration instructions for supported email providers, usage examples, command-line options, and common troubleshooting tips.
- Clarified requirements for special providers like Gmail and 163.com, including app passwords and authorization codes.
- Added sections for security and dependencies, helping users set up and operate the skill more reliably.
